headerIdentity.title: Name and autosave
headerIdentity.description: Set the page name here. Changes save automatically as you work.

toolbarViews.title: Edit or preview
toolbarViews.description: Switch between the editor and a live preview of the page.

toolbarViewport.title: Check every screen size
toolbarViewport.description: Review and fine-tune how the page looks on mobile, tablet, and desktop.

toolbarHistory.title: Undo anytime
toolbarHistory.description: Every change can be undone or redone, so feel free to experiment.

sidebarTabs.title: Components and templates
sidebarTabs.description: Start from a single element or from a ready-made section layout.

sidebarPalette.title: Drag onto the canvas
sidebarPalette.description: Drag any element or section from here straight onto the page.

sidebarTemplates.title: Page templates
sidebarTemplates.description: This tab holds whole pages ready to use as a starting point. Applying one replaces the current page, so it asks you to confirm first.

canvasFrame.title: The canvas
canvasFrame.description: Click an element to select it, or drop one in from the panel to add it.

canvasNodeActions.title: Duplicate or delete
canvasNodeActions.description: Once an element is selected, duplicate or remove it from this side rail.

inspectorTabs.title: Content, style, interactivity
inspectorTabs.description: The selected element's content, styling, and interactive behavior all live in these tabs.

inspectorBreakpoints.title: Style per screen size
inspectorBreakpoints.description: Fine-tune how the selected element looks at each breakpoint, from mobile to desktop.

settingsTabs.title: The page's settings
settingsTabs.description: This is where the whole page is configured: layers, pages, themes, SEO, languages, publishing, and settings. Each tab opens a different section.

settingsLayers.title: Layers
settingsLayers.description: This is the full structure of the page, as a tree. Use it to select an element that's nested inside another one.

settingsPages.title: Pages
settingsPages.description: This is where a page becomes a multi-page site. Add a new page, rename it, or switch to another one whenever you want.

settingsLanguages.title: Languages
settingsLanguages.description: This is where the site's content languages live. Add a language, then translate the page's content into it.

pagesBreadcrumb.title: A page is one of many
pagesBreadcrumb.description: A single project can hold multiple pages — use this breadcrumb to jump between them.

publish.title: Publish
publish.description: Publish the site and pick its subdomain from here.

profileMenu.title: Editor preferences
profileMenu.description: Switch the editor language, color theme, experience level, and reorder controls.
